scripts.build: corepack pnpm check-locales && corepack pnpm --filter @mova/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @mova/web build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web packages/contracts/src scripts/check-locales.mjs scripts/check-direct-reads.mjs scripts/check-direct-reads.test.mjs scripts/check-public-locale-contrast.test.mjs scripts/check-applied-migrations.mjs scripts/db-test.mjs scripts/fn-check.mjs scripts/run-e2e.mjs scripts/test-handle-claim-race.mjs scripts/verify-p01.mjs scripts/verify-p02.mjs tests playwright.config.ts playwright.visual.config.ts && node scripts/check-direct-reads.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @mova/contracts build && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --filter @mova/contracts typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @mova/contracts build && vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts && node --test scripts/check-direct-reads.test.mjs scripts/check-public-locale-contrast.test.mjs
